placement: ResourceSourceContext collection after raw metadata/selectors and before native.pages allocation and native observation.
checks: Referenced root/user descriptors only, complete descriptor SHA binding, security-ID/legacy identity, exact shared SDK layout/profile/hash transform, source owner revalidation and complete root/user coverage.
memory: SourceScratch leases pay the current row/transform workspace and descriptor-digest set. No descriptors are retained in a new unaccounted collection.
refusal: A small diagnostic records source identity, descriptor hash and exact reason before expensive native capture. It grants no source admission or write authority.
